title: CFDE KC Gene Set Browser
bodyHtml:
Connecting gene sets to human phenotypes


To get started, select a CFDE program by clicking the blue buttons or select a search type below. Search by phenotype, gene, list of genes, gene set ID, or CFDE program(s). Sample search terms are shown for each search type after you've made your selection.

Connecting cross-CFDE gene sets to human phenotypes and mechanisms via human genetics

Which CFDE gene sets capture important mechanisms?
Which mechanisms are relevant to human health?

This workflow uses a novel Bayesian method, PIGEAN (Priors Inferred from GEne ANnotations), to infer phenotypes, additional genes, and mechanisms that may be related to a list of genes (gene set). CFDE gene sets were generated by the CFDE Data Resource Center.

Click the Research Method tab for details about datasets, gene sets, phenotypes, and analysis methods.

Filter above the plot to narrow results.

Hover over table column names for more information.

Click show in the table to learn about the factors that contribute to each result.
